MORE:
We would like to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company in the Meeting eld today 14th August, 2026, have inter-alia considered and approved Un-Audited Standalone Financial Results of the company for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026 as enclosed.
A copy of un-audited standalone financial results along with the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors of the Company on such financial for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026 is attached herewith.
NEWSSUB: Financial Results For The Quarter Ended 30Th June, 2026
